exam_scheme.note: The Common Management Admission Test (CMAT) is a national-level Computer Based Test (CBT) administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Ministry of Education and AICTE for admission to MBA, PGDM, and Executive PGDM programmes across participating management institutions in India. The examination has a duration of 180 minutes (3 hours) and consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 400 marks. The test is structured into five mandatory sections of 20 questions (80 marks) each: Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, and Innovation & Entrepreneurship. Marking scheme: 4 marks awarded for each correct response, 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response (-1 negative marking), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
